question: What is the meaning of percentage of realistic reuse of an object or part of an object in relation to protection of material stocks?
data_point: percentage of realistic reuse of an object or part of an object
description: The percentage of realistic reuse of an object or part of an object in relation to the protection of material stocks refers to the proportion of materials that can be feasibly repurposed or recycled within the construction industry, contributing to the conservation and efficient use of raw materials. This concept is integral to achieving circular economy (CE) goals, where the aim is to minimize waste and maximize the lifecycle of materials through reuse and recycling, thereby protecting and preserving material stocks. This approach supports sustainable construction practices by reducing the need for new raw materials and mitigating the environmental impact of construction activities.
